title: Patch: Immutable keeps Last Hurrah's Flashback off a card in the hand, and its random picks skip Immutable cards
notes: Issue #5226 (R5226000): a keyword another card gives for good (gainKeywordForGood) is kept off an Immutable card, an Indestructible Unit card's included (R4353000); C #37 Last Hurrah's random picks skip Immutable cards and its Radiant face gives Flashback to every other hand card. A card's own keyword for good (S #154 Dice of Doom) is unchanged (R23). Last Hurrah keeps its old script for replays.

player.title: Last Hurrah passes Immutable cards by
changes: Last Hurrah's random picks now fall only on cards that can take Flashback, and its Radiant face gives it to every card in your hand that can take it.
fixes: Last Hurrah no longer gives Flashback to an Immutable card in your hand, such as Phase Wall, Megabase or The Rock.
